derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G2632 (κατακρίνω);

occurrences.text: But Paul said unto them, They have beaten us openly uncondemned, being Romans, and have cast us into prison; and now do they thrust us out privily? nay verily; but let them come themselves and fetch us out.
